producer_judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Skills Objectives in P1 Unit 1 'Numbers from 1 to 5' (same rank 0, so direction rests on content, not coordinate). The second SFI is numeral recognition ('Read whole numbers from 1 to 5 wherever they are written'), while the first requires operating on and recording those numbers ('Add and subtract numbers by counting and writing (the sum should not exceed 5)'), with LCs specifying adding/subtracting whole numbers 1-5 by counting and writing. Fluent reading of the numerals 1-5 substantively supports success in written counting-based addition and subtraction within the same range, so the reading objective builds towards the operations objective; the shared Unit/Topic Area and LC token overlap only nominated the pair. Source evidence for both endpoints is truncated (24 omitted items each), but the retained excerpts and LCs are unambiguous, so this does not materially limit the judgment.
